newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds shrug off FOMC announcement.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds shrug off FOMC announcement.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities prices barely moved after the Federal Reserve ended its policy meeting with no change in interest rates.
Yield spreads remained wider after the meeting's close, and Treasuries were moderately higher across the curve, traders said.
"Spreads are still wider, they've been wider all day," said a trader at a Japenese bank. "There's been very little customer activity since the FOMC."
In specific issues, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent pass-throughs were off 2/32 at 99-8/32 to yield 100 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae paper was up 2/32 at 99-11/32, and Freddie Mac 7.5s were unchanged at 99-15/32.
Treasuries jerked higher and then lower after the FOMC confab ended, with the 10-year note off 1/32 to yield 6.72 percent at 1450 EDT/1850 GMT.
